question: What is the rate of interest paid on the bonds issued under the Sovereign Gold Bond Scheme of the Reserve Bank of India?
solution:
The correct answer is** ​**__**2.50% per annum**__.

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The interest for the** gold bonds will be 2.50% per annum** which is payable semi-early on the nominal value.
 
• The tenure of the bond will be for **8 years** with an exit option available in the **5th, 6th**,** and 7th year on the dates of interest payment.**
 
• Prices of a sovereign gold bond** 2020** are calculated through a simple average of the final prices of **999 purity gold for the previous 3 days set by the Indian Bullion and Jewellers Association Limited (IBJA).**
 
• Interest earned on** SGBs** is taxable as income from other sources, whereas **TDS **does not apply to bonds. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Bonds will be termed in multiples of **gram(s) of gold with a basic unit of 1 gram.**
 
• The **Reserve Bank of India** ((RBI) in place of the center has a fixed issue** price of ₹5,197 per gram.**
 
• Sovereign Gold Bond Scheme is a** worthwhile investment. **
 
• It earns not only interest but as well **potential capital appreciation.​ **

c1:T
